identity_reason: text takes its size, tone and weight from the type scale, so it has no form of its own to derive
concept: Text at a step of the type scale in one of the two text tones, so no screen sets a size or an opacity by hand.

root.why: sets the family and no margin so text sits on the rhythm of its container

reading.why: the 16px reading size with long-form leading and the measure for paragraphs

body.why: the 15px default size for interface text and short paragraphs

label.why: the 14px size for labels next to controls and in rows

caption.why: the 13px size for captions and supporting details under content

micro.why: the 11px size, tracked out, for the smallest labels and counts

primary.why: the primary text colour, which flips with the theme against the glass

secondary.why: the secondary tone, the lowest opacity that still measured as passing

regular.why: the regular weight for running text and most labels in the interface

medium.why: the medium weight to lift a label without making it a heading

semibold.why: the semibold weight for names and the one emphasis in a row

truncate.why: cuts a single line with an ellipsis where the space cannot grow
